applies_to: gameplay.item_state exact replay when the patch major is 15 (ItemStateIndex with patch; rules_15x=None decides by the patch, False switches them off); a replay without a patch, of patch major 16 (item_rules_16x.json) or of any other major never reads this file
source: events of the 15.14 rule-check sample (300 cache matches, 3,000 players; ev4_s1_item_gold.samples()['rule_check'], seed 20260925) and of the FIRST KR 15.18 sample (500 matches, 5,000 players; records/replication_exclusions_inventory_1518.txt: timeline ITEM_* / LEVEL_UP / ELITE_MONSTER_KILL events and detail item0-6 at game end, outcome keys dropped at parse).  The fresh KR 15.18 validation sample was not read.  Counts produced by scripts/exact_v4/ev4_s1y_items_15x.py evidence -> stage1/item_state_15x/rules_evidence_15x.json

rules.rule: Symbiotic Soles: a loose destroy (not consumed by a purchase at that ms) of a held 3010 turns it into 3013 Synchronized Souls (Data Dragon 3013 from=[3010], gold_base 0, no specialRecipe); not applied to a destroy that is a Viego possession swap

trinket slot at 0 ms: 3340 Stealth Ward; 3330 Scarecrow Effigy for Fiddlesticks (championId 9, Data Dragon requiredChampion FiddleSticks).  The game gives the starting trinket without an event unless the player picks one in the shop (R15-3)

15.14 rule-check.fiddlesticks: 13 players: 11 without trinket events, 2 first event ITEM_DESTROYED 3330

no_trinket_event_item6.0: 5 (all with 0 ITEM_* events, remakes ending <= 104 s: not modelled)

rules.rule: a trinket purchase without a same-ms trinket destroy replaces the held trinket (the starting pick in the shop); its undo (beforeId 0 / afterId X / goldGain 0, item_state rule 1) gives the replaced trinket back.  A purchase with a same-ms trinket destroy is the ordinary swap (existing rule)
rune Biscuit Delivery (8345): 2010 at 2:00, 4:00 and 6:00 (same schedule as R16-11)

KR 15.18 first sample.rune_players_2010_in_item0_5: 24 (9 in games ending before 4:00 without a 2010 event; 15 with 3 due and 0-2 events)

rules.rule: Eye of the Herald: a loose destroy of a held trinket with no trinket purchased at that ms puts 3513 into the trinket slot (the trinket is stored); the destroy of the held 3513 (used) gives the stored trinket back

KR 15.18 first sample.3513_used_item6_is_the_stored_trinket: 410; the other 11 bought a trinket after the 3513 destroy

rules.rule: Viego: a lone loose trinket destroy (the only loose destroy at that ms) and the destroy of a held 3513 are not possession swaps (they go to R15-6 / the ordinary swap)

not_modelled.starting trinket of AFK players: 5 KR players with 0 ITEM_* events in remakes (<= 104 s) end with item6 0; the replay gives them 3340
not_modelled.3867 upgrade choice: the support-item upgrade (3869 / 3870 / 3871 / 3876 / 3877) is chosen without an event; the replay keeps 3867 as its proxy (item_state rule 3); the author's strict measure treats the six ids as one class
not_modelled.8313 Triple Tonic elixirs (2150 / 2151 /: not granted by the replay: rule R15-5 was removed by author decision (see removed_rules); their ITEM_DESTROYED events without a held copy are counted as unowned removals, not guessed
not_modelled.3400 Your Cut / 3599 Kalista's Black Spe: destroys of items created without events, never held at game end (unowned removals only)

removed_rules.decision: REMOVE (was not on the author's rule list). The fresh KR 15.18 sample is re-measured without it; that result must not be used to change any rule.
removed_rules.removed_rule_text: rune Triple Tonic (8313): 2151 at the LEVEL_UP to 3, 2152 at the LEVEL_UP to 6 (as R16-12); 2150 (level 9) is not granted

not_granted.2150: Elixir of Skill at level 9 is not granted (as R16-12): 15.14 49/80 and KR 74/98 rune players reaching level 9 have a 2150 event; no stats, 0 gold in Data Dragon

removed_rules.note: rule ids are not renumbered: R15-6 / R15-7 keep their ids
